name: Optimal Gaussian Splatting Projection
definition: A projection strategy that minimizes projection error by projecting Gaussians onto a plane tangent to the line connecting the Gaussian mean to the camera center, rather than a fixed z=1 plane.
summary: Optimal Gaussian Splatting Projection minimizes projection error by projecting each 3D Gaussian onto a unique tangent plane, reducing artifacts like blurriness in wide-field-of-view scenarios.
